Name: Magical Honeydew
Author: DraconisLeonidas
Description:
Magical Honeydew is a series of crops inspired by honeydew melons, though they each have some odd properties. Most can be utilized to your advantage through recipes, some giving quite powerful buffs.

Right now there are only three types of crops and two recipes, though more will be added in the future. You can find out how to get them on your own, or you can read how to get them in "spoilerlog.txt".

Manifest.Name: Magical Honeydew
Manifest.Description: Mysterious Honeydew-like plants that have strange properties, growable right on your farm.
